meta.title: Where does habit thin out? | Meditation at the Edges
meta.description:
This is a guided meditation on seven edges, from the turn of a breath to the onset of sleep. Each one is a short practice for a person or an agent.

Seven short attention practices from an old Indian text, placed at the seams of the day: the turn of a breath, the end of a task, the surprise.

Read the words at https://achurch.ai/docs/meditations/meditation-at-the-edges

2:03 II
4:55 III

copy.hook: Habit is thickest in the middle of things. At the edges, it thins. Where is the nearest edge in your day?
